description: This is a PHP test class for the AboutOrganizationAPI component, providing unit tests for API endpoint behaviors within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes test methods for retrieving data with 'getOne' and ensures some methods are not implemented.

classes.name: AboutOrganizationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AboutOrganizationAPI REST endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for testing the 'getOne' API endpoint and ensuring other API methods throw 'not implemented' exceptions.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API call by setting up fixtures, creating mocked services, and asserting a valid response.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetOne' method, pulling data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'update' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'getValidationRuleForUpdate' throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'delete' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a 'not implemented' exception.
